topic: SC: drug users victims hain - NDPS prosecution quashed (Sanjana Bhaskaran v. State of Telangana)

slides.title: Drug user **victim** hai, sirf criminal nahi
slides.subtitle: Supreme Court ne ek college student ke khilaf NDPS case **quash** kar diya. Jaaniye kyun.
slides.cite: **Sanjana Bhaskaran v. State of Telangana**, 2026 LiveLaw (SC) 1044 · Justice J.B. Pardiwala & Justice K. Vinod Chandran

slides.label: Case kya tha
slides.title: Ek packet ganja ka aarop
bullets: Police ka kehna tha ki ladki ne college ke paas **do logon se ganje ka packet** liya aur bag mein rakh liya.
Police ne teeno ko pakad liya. Baaki do ke scooter mein **zyada quantity** milne ka aarop tha.
Lekin police ke apne bayan ke mutabiq ladki ya uske bag se **kuch bhi baramad nahi hua**.

slides.label: Court ne kya kaha
slides.title: User supply chain ka **aakhri sira** hai
bullets: Nasha karne wale log drug chain ke last end par hote hain. Unhe **victim** maana jaana chahiye, sirf offender nahi.
Trial se pehle jail bhejne par woh andar aise logon ke sampark mein aa sakte hain jo unhe **drug trade mein aur gehra** dhakel dein.
Asli focus **supply chain todne** aur nashe ki availability rokne par hona chahiye.

slides.label: Case kyun khatam hua
slides.title: Na recovery, na bharosemand saboot
bullets: Case sirf **co-accused ke bayan** aur ladki ke kathit **confession** par tika tha.
Court ne kaha ki aise confession ko conviction ka aadhar nahi banaya ja sakta.
Jab kuch baramad hi nahi hua, toh prosecution chalaane ka **koi faayda nahi**. Appeal allow hui, case **quash**.
slides.note: Kanoon ka fact: Police ke saamne kiya gaya confession court mein uske khilaf saboot nahi hota — **Section 23 BSA** (pehle Section 25, Evidence Act).

slides.label: Dhyan rahe
slides.title: Yeh faisla nasha **legal nahi** karta
bullets: NDPS Act mein drug consume karna aaj bhi **apradh** hai (**Section 27**). Supply aur trafficking par saza aur bhi sakht hai.
Lekin **Section 64A** ek raasta deta hai: chhote maamlon mein jo addict khud **ilaaj ke liye aage aata hai**, use prosecution se chhoot mil sakti hai.
Har case ke facts alag hote hain. Apne maamle mein kisi vakeel se salah zaroor lein.

slides.title: Kanoon samjho, **haq** jaano
lines: Har din ek naya faisla, aasaan bhasha mein.
**Save** karein, aur jise zaroorat ho usse **share** karein.

caption:
Drug user = victim, sirf criminal nahi? ⚖️

Supreme Court ne Telangana ki ek college student ke khilaf NDPS case quash kar diya. Aarop tha ki usne college ke paas ganje ka packet liya — lekin uske paas se kuch baramad hi nahi hua, aur case sirf co-accused ke bayan aur confession par tika tha.

Court ne kaha: nasha karne wale log drug chain ke aakhri sire par hote hain. Unhe jail mein daalne se woh drug trade mein aur gehre ja sakte hain. Asli focus supply chain todne par hona chahiye.

📌 Yaad rakhein: police ke saamne kiya gaya confession court mein saboot nahi hota (Section 23 BSA). Aur NDPS mein consumption aaj bhi apradh hai — yeh faisla nasha legal nahi karta.

Case: Sanjana Bhaskaran v. State of Telangana, 2026 LiveLaw (SC) 1044
Bench: Justice J.B. Pardiwala & Justice K. Vinod Chandran
